title: NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover breaks historic record after traveling 28 miles
caption:
NASA’s Perseverance rover has officially traveled over 28 miles on Mars, setting a new record for off-world driving. The achievement proves that our autonomous systems can handle the harsh Martian terrain.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover breaks historic record after traveling 28 miles
